steps.title: Harvest Bacteria
steps.instruction: Pellet the bacteria culture in a 1.6mL centrifugation tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 1 minute.
Decant the supernatant.
Optional: Store pellet at -20°C if immediate processing is not possible.

steps.title: Resuspend Bacteria
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet using resuspension solution (P1 with RNase).

substeps.instruction: Add 250uL of P1 with RNase.
Vortex the mixture.

steps.title: Lyse Bacteria
steps.instruction: Lyse the bacteria using lysis solution (P2).

substeps.instruction: Add 250uL of lysis solution (P2).
Invert gently 4-6 times.

steps.title: Neutralize Lysate
steps.instruction: Neutralize the solution using neutralization solution (P3).

substeps.instruction: Add 350uL of neutralization solution (P3).
Invert gently 4-6 times (do not vortex to avoid genomic DNA contamination).

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column
steps.instruction: Bind the plasmid DNA to the column.

substeps.instruction: Decant the clear supernatant (avoiding the white protein cloud) into the column.
Centrifuge at 13,300 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Wash Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column to remove contaminants using wash solution (PW2).

substeps.instruction: Add 600uL of PW2 (ensure pure ethanol was added to PW2 as per bottle instructions) and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Discard the flow-through.
Add another 600uL of PW2 and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Discard the flow-through and centrifuge the column again for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Elute Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified plasmid DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Keep the cap open and wait until the ethanol smell is gone.
Move the column into a new centrifugation tube.
Add 50uL of elution buffer (TE; 10 mM Tris-Cl, 1 mM EDTA). Note: Pre-warm TE to 50°C for low-copy plasmids like pET28.
Centrifuge for 1 minute and collect the flow-through containing the plasmid DNA.
Spin at 13,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
